target_customer: Robotics companies that need to teleoperate and supervise deployed robots
problem: Deployed robots fail in the field and need a human to step in instantly to keep uptime high.
business_model: B2B software platform (Sentinel) for teleoperation and fleet operations
product_category: Robot teleoperation and fleet operations software

competitors.name: Formant
competitors.what: Cloud robot operations and browser teleoperation platform

competitors.name: Foxglove
competitors.what: Robotics observability with remote access and teleoperation features

technical_complexity.rationale: Ultra low latency video and control over networks to heterogeneous robots with VR headsets, plus fleet operations, is hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with customer robots create some lock in, but established vendors already offered teleoperation and the product was a few months old.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A robotics startup, Foundry Robotics, acquired it in October 2026 rather than an incumbent copying it.

market_need_then: Humanoid and field robot makers in 2026 needed teleoperation both to recover from failures and to collect training data; Sentinel's own site frames a learning loop that turns field data into training data.

identity.logo: Wordmark in site header and footer, not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Infrastructure positioning: 'The infrastructure layer for deploying robots'

branding.brand_signature: Product brand Sentinel, launched publicly June 1, 2026

brand_strength.rationale: Brand was a few months old and no press or community about it was found; the name is shared with an unrelated Swiss supplement company, which can confuse searches.

outcome_analysis: Avea Robotics joined YC in Spring 2026 with two founders and shipped the Sentinel teleoperation platform, launched publicly on June 1, 2026. By its own site it is now part of Foundry Robotics, which announced a $100M Series A and the Avea purchase in late October 2026. Terms are undisclosed, so whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing is not known.
notes: No funding found for Avea beyond the YC standard deal; coverage is none_found, not zero. Acquisition date conflicts: Goodwin release Oct 29 2026, Multiples.vc Oct 7 2026, Fundz Nov 2 2026 (spelled Avec); 2026-10 used. Founder backgrounds were not found. Competitor source dates are of the cited pages, not the founding; no teleoperation launches dated at the batch were retrieved.
